findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Potential timing attack
 * @description Comparing cryptographic signatures or tokens using standard comparison operators can verify in non-constant time, leading to timing attacks.
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/timing-attack
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-208
 */

import python
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::Node compare, DataFlow::Node left, DataFlow::Node right
where
  compare.asExpr() instanceof Compare and
  (
    compare.asExpr().(Compare).getOp(0) instanceof Eq or
    compare.asExpr().(Compare).getOp(0) instanceof NotEq
  ) and
  left.asExpr() = compare.asExpr().(Compare).getLeft() and
  right.asExpr() = compare.asExpr().(Compare).getComparator(0) and
  (
    // Look for variable names suggesting sensitive data
    left.asExpr().(Name).getId().matches("%signature%") or
    left.asExpr().(Name).getId().matches("%token%") or
    left.asExpr().(Name).getId().matches("%secret%") or
    left.asExpr().(Name).getId().matches("%hash%") or
    left.asExpr().(Name).getId().matches("%mac%") or
    right.asExpr().(Name).getId().matches("%signature%") or
    right.asExpr().(Name).getId().matches("%token%") or
    right.asExpr().(Name).getId().matches("%secret%") or
    right.asExpr().(Name).getId().matches("%hash%") or
    right.asExpr().(Name).getId().matches("%mac%")
  )
select compare, "Potential timing attack: Sensitive data compared using non-constant time operator."
findings.hypothesis: Comparisons of sensitive data (tokens, signatures) using == or != instead of constant-time comparison functions like hmac.compare_digest.

 */
import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call.getLocation().getFile().getShortName() = "tokens.py" and
  call.getLocation().getStartLine() = 131
select call, "Context for weak hash usage"
findings.hypothesis: Context verification for weak hash usage

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Weak Cryptographic Hash
 * @description Use of weak cryptographic hashing algorithms (MD5, SHA1) is insecure.
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/weak-crypto-hash
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-327
 *       external/cwe/cwe-328
 */
import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::moduleImport("hashlib").getMember(["md5", "sha1"]).getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("Crypto.Hash.MD5").getMember("new").getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("Crypto.Hash.SHA1").getMember("new").getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("cryptography.hazmat.primitives.hashes").getMember(["MD5", "SHA1"]).getACall()
select call, "Usage of weak cryptographic hash function."
findings.hypothesis: Usage of weak hashing algorithms like MD5 or SHA1.
